changes.description: Added a loading screen.
Compress high-depth strips and embed descriptive XMP.
Initialize bracket exposures from EXIF.
Measure editable variable-width centerlines.
Preserve grayscale profiles and extended GIMP blend semantics.
Render and retain turbulence and displacement filters.
Separate placed photographs and tiling patterns for PDF/X.
Preserve procedural filter coordinates during export.
Various fixes in batch operations.
Improved some dialogs UI and UX.
Improved the "recent documents" card.
Various fixes and improvements.
Now displaying a warning message for mobile users.
Avoided rebuilding layer controls on pixel edits.
Bound preparation work and resource collection memory.
Bounded download buffers while preserving throughput.
Bounded vector thumbnails and shared histogram caching.
Further reduced subject segmentation memory peaks.
Improved live paint performance.
Improved vector documents spaning & zooming speed.
Moved native vector JSON work off the UI thread.
Reduced selection inspection and geometry work.
Retained bounded vector proof and comparison preparation.
Scoped document updates and isolated layer hover feedback.
Shared lazy geometry across vector editor consumers.
Shared lazy timelines between image and vector editors.
Shared retained vector projections across inspection tasks.
Added AI noise reduction and super resolution.
Added an AI method to Content-Aware Fill powered by LaMa.
Added native text-path geometry, predefined paragraph lists and Adobe variable-font instance names.
Added on-device Select Subject and Remove Background with downloadable models.
Added paint symmetry to the brush, pencil and eraser.
Added shared progress, cancellation and partial results.
Added sky replacement and kept the canvas painted while a prepared composite starts.
Added support for APNG and animated WebPs.
Added texture, clarity, dehaze, color grading and grain to Camera Raw.
Added the Object selection tool powered by SAM 2.1.
Added the ability to have a checkerboard background for vector documents.
Added the blob brush and the perspective grid.
Added tips about the vector editor and other features.
Enabled web as a target platform.
Implemented replayable vector library actions.
Improved gradients and texts handling.
Improved live paint.
Kept native precision and colour space in AI noise reduction and super resolution.
Kept native precision and colour space in the AI Content-Aware Fill.
Moved the built-in skies to an asset, accepted gradient files and removed the halo around branches in sky replacement.
Now displaying ONNX in the app settings.
Now displaying local models size in the app settings.
Opened CIELab and ICCLab TIFF files as Lab documents.
Opened the AI tools to CMYK, Lab and grayscale documents.
Shared destinations and repeat exports across editors.
Shared file drops, color sampling and keyboard pane navigation.
Shared reversible blend previews across editors.
Shared shortcut aliases and temporary vector tools.
Unified persistence and history feedback.
Added grain during the 16-bit conversion and processed presence, grading and grain row by row.
Adjusted macOS spacing for rounded window corners.
Aligned Sentry pins and reviewed native recipes.
Asked once before replacing a destination in both editors.
Bound shared navigator controls to their own views.
Bound text panels and dimensions to their documents.
Bound vector readouts and sampling to their owning views.
Classified protected placements and forwarded canvas wheel input.
Completed view input lifecycles and shared display controls.
Corrected Wayland offsets and large soft brush gradients.
Corrected content-aware sampling and colour adaptation.
Corrected sky replacement and made bright halo reduction optional.
Finalized shared shortcut and preview lifecycles.
Fixed regressions from the paste, blend preview and proof review.
Fixed regressions from the persistence and shortcut review.
Fixed regressions from the progress and preview review.
Fixed regressions from the scoped barriers, gradient and inspection review.
Fixed regressions from the shared input and export review.
Fixed stale paint command availability and shared warp overlay painting from the application review.
Fixed stale segmentation results and bounded model sessions.
Harmonized recent editor surfaces and bounded Camera Raw mask inputs.
Harmonized selector focus and adopted ForUI menu semantics.
Kept proofing and display modes independent per view.
Kept search and spelling bound to their document lifetime.
Open encrypted documents and unify canvas scrolling.
Precache only the current worker and runtime versions.
Preserved coherent saves, exports and preview targets.
Preserved result placement and cancelled superseded selections.
Preserved translucent pixels and stabilized browser validation.
Reduced subject segmentation memory peaks.
Repaired macOS inference and now downloading notarized runtimes on demand.
Restore locked setup in a fresh checkout.
Restored page loading and visible canvas scrolling.
Retained bounded previews with each frame's resources.
Scoped operation barriers and command admission to documents.
Serialized document pastes with shared activity feedback.
Shared complete wheel and trackpad navigation.
Shared playback visibility across editor presentations.
Various UI fixes and improvements.
Various fixes and improvements.
Cleaned analyzer hints in shared editor regressions.
Integrate concurrent browser fixes and validation guidance.
Removed redundant blend preview import.
Shared more mechanisms between the raster and the vector editors.
Various fixes and improvements.
Retained gradient and composition state per document.
Separated resource services and streamlined clipboard encoding.
Shared comparison hosting and originating view scope.
Shared window placement between photo and vector documents in the view registry.
Unified the photo and vector view registries and viewport controllers.
Improved PDF rendering and editing.
Kept Live Paint parts, projected bounds and stroke outlines across scene edits.
Improved PDF support.
Fixed an error related to temporary files naming in the user home directory.
Fixed an occurring while using `Apply an image`.
Fixed some errors related to misread PSD blocks.
Fixed tool defects found while drawing raster and vector artwork.
Now distributing the correct VC++ DDLs alongside the Focale binaries.
PDF canvas is now white.
Preserve modified deletion shortcuts.
Preserve ownership when opening is canceled.
Preserve rendered pixels and reopen tiled projects.
Preserve transparent GIF frames.
Respect vector content locks.
Serialize cancellation and recover failed shutdowns.
Now using a more neutral tone in some languages.
Cleaned-up some internal code.
Fixed audited persistence and editing regressions.
Fixed various compilation errors.
Updated release utility.
Optimized pixel processing, color conversion and multicore native rendering.
Faster canvas navigation and display of raster documents.
Improved gradient editing and reduced slowdowns with 16-bit images.
Reduced rendering work and panel rebuilds while editing vector documents.
Added a vector editor.
Added editable GIMP XCF support.
Added SVG filters support.
Added settings to show tab list buttons and the panel collapse button.
Fixed transparency handling in eyedropper and color sampler measurements.
Fixed Linux restart after automatic updates.
Restored Linux title-bar interactions and transparent window margins.
Fixed the application freezing when quitting.
Save now preserves embedded color profiles and 16-bit precision in eligible PNG documents.
Improved document opening progress and bounded recovery decoding by the history memory limit.
Improved SVG import compatibility with embedded images, font-size keywords and conditional content.
Fixed open Pen paths and completion of vector drawing and selection gestures.
Fixed selection outlines on transformed layers and kept queued painting tied to the selected target.
Color Range and color-based selections now use the visible animation frame and reject stale results.
Quick Export now lets users choose a filename when exporting a single output.
Localized new vector object and image file names.
Harmonized panels, toolbars, document tabs and failure notices across editors.
Removed the alpha founders dialog from App Store builds.
Now unblocking native notice review and automating proposal PRs.
Faster canvas compositing for opacity, clipping, adjustments and custom blends.
Improved startup time.
Reduced editor rebuilds and redundant rendering.
Removed menu action delays and redundant thumbnail captures.
Implemented native brush composition and extended color processing.
Now preserving exact document colors across editing, pickers and PSD.
Now showing the release notes corresponding to the difference between the current version and the latest version.
Adjustments, Camera Raw, Apply Image and exports keep HDR and wide-gamut colors.
Copies, cuts and background renders keep high-depth precision.
Distinguish file access failures from image format errors
Fixed "File > Save" and/or CTRL+S opening a save dialog for 1-layer PNG files.
Hide external support links in Mac App Store builds.
Now reporting file access failures with actionable recovery.
Preserved precision across native editing and interchange.
Removed the 16 px space between dialogs border and vertical scrollbar.
Added a `CompositePlan` to compute the structural paint decisions of a document once before painting.
Updated DBUS slot name.
Updated the design of tool parameters (better coherence and harmony).
Various simplifications and bugs fixes in the app codebase.
Now using `pickpick` to pick on-screen colors.
Replaced kernel templates with analyzable Dart sources.
Share duplicated editing, shader, RAW and blur code.
Unified high-precision compositing across canvas, merges, and exports.
Fixed a compilation problem.
Improved build scripts.
Fixed a gradient rendering problem.
Fixed a bug with asynchronous loading of translations.
Fixed various bugs with the Eraser tool.
Added `snap` as a distribution target.
Improved the new document dialog UI.
Various QoL improvements.
Improved the Fill tool performances.
Fixed a bug with text alignments.
Added more keyboard shortcuts when editing a text.
Localized the app in more languages (es, pt, de, it).
Added a startup splash screen displaying initialization progress.
Added merge actions to the layer context menu.
Now stacking dithered gradient layers.
Fixed a blink bug that was occurring when zooming / moving the canvas.
Fixed gradient banding on the home screen.
Built-in brushes are now saved as `fbrush` presets.
Built-in coutours, swatches, gradients, curves and styles are now saved as `fcontour`, `fswatch`, `fgradient`, `fcurve` and `fstyle` presets.
Built-in patterns are now saved as `fpattern` presets.
Built-in shapes are now saved as `fshape` presets.
Improved the home screen UI.
Now preventing the update dialog from closing while working.
Updated the hero background.
Updated the website branding.
Various UI improvements.
Updated Sentry license notices and reviewed dependency metadata.
Improved license reviewing by adding a Github workflow dedicated to it.
Added Photoshop contours support.
Added exact layer-effect contours, Porter-Duff blending, and native adjustment presets.
Added portable presets and improved Photoshop style fidelity.
Added support for more Photoshop formats.
Added an auto-update dialog.
Now concurrently decoding and prefetching project raster tiles.
Updated the database directory in release mode.
Updated release pipeline.
Fixed a permission error on Linux.
Moved the build script to `get-focale`.
Fixed various compilation errors.
Initial release.
